title: Check passports (yours and your wife's)
detail: Each should be valid for at least 2 years. Renew now if not.

title: Get NSU documents
detail: Transcript, certificate, and a Medium of Instruction (English) letter. Get attested and scanned copies.

title: Book and take IELTS Academic
detail: Target 7.0, with no band below 6.5. Book a December date so results arrive before the January deadlines.

title: Ask 2 NSU professors for recommendation letters
detail: Pick finance faculty who know your work. Send them your CV and target list.

title: Europass CV and master statement of purpose
detail: We draft these together, then tailor them for each programme.

title: Start German A1
detail: Goethe-Institut Dhaka or an online course. A1 → B1 opens jobs and foundation scholarships.

title: Get a finance or analytics job or internship
detail: Even 1 year helps the SOP. 2 years makes you eligible for DAAD EPOS.

title: Shortlist Erasmus Mundus programmes
detail: Pick 4–6, then apply to the best 3. Check maths and English requirements.

title: Submit Erasmus Mundus applications
detail: GrEnFIn 7 Jan · GLOCAL 14 Jan · EPOG 27 Jan (verify each)

title: Submit Stipendium Hungaricum
detail: Apply in the online portal and complete the Bangladesh Ministry of Education nomination.

title: Shortlist 6–8 tuition-free German MSc programmes
detail: Finance, Business Analytics, FinTech, Management. Use the DAAD database.

title: Create a uni-assist account and get a VPD if needed
detail: Many universities check foreign degrees through uni-assist. Allow 4–6 weeks.

title: Submit all German applications
detail: Most winter deadlines fall between 15 Apr and 15 Jul 2027.

title: Have the blocked-account money ready
detail: €11,904 for 1 year (2026 figure), plus about €1,500 for flights, insurance and deposit.

title: Register on the embassy waiting list immediately
detail: Join through the Consular Services Portal the day the admission letter arrives.

title: Open blocked account and buy health insurance
detail: Expatrio, Fintiba or Coracle. Get the confirmation letter for VFS.

title: Prepare VFS visa file
detail: Follow the embassy's Master's checklist exactly. Use originals plus copies.

title: Apply for the Deutschlandstipendium and a part-time job
detail: Students may work 140 full days or 280 half days per year.

title: Plan your wife's move
detail: She finishes her degree around mid-2027. Option A: she applies for Winter 2028 as a student. Option B: family reunion visa once your funds allow.

title: Long-term path to settling
detail: Master's → 18-month job-seeker permit → job / EU Blue Card → permanent residence. A German PhD is usually a paid job.
